description: Checked-in analytical table has exact schema complete mover/altitude/latitude coverage unique keys finite values and agreement with the independently recomputed Stoermer formula
Every required AMPS process returns zero and produces an identifiable shell product; diagnostic GC cases report failures without changing the test exit status
Tecplot VARIABLES and every row width are explicit; positional cutoff-column guesses are forbidden
Output contains exactly two complete 30-by-15-degree shell grids with no missing unexpected or duplicate coordinates
All scientific values are finite and nonnegative; any reported unresolved or range flag fails a required case
Every full-orbit mover satisfies its declared accuracy class: 15 percent mid-latitude for BORIS/RK2 5 percent for RK4/RK6 and 25 percent at high latitude
Successive cutoff-map differences are recorded but are not an order gate while ADAPTIVE_DT is enabled
With ADAPTIVE_DT disabled users may require that the fine/medium normalized RMS difference not materially exceed the medium/coarse difference
RK4 and RK6 agree within the high-order absolute-plus-relative spread envelope
BORIS RK2 RK4 and RK6 are compared with a wider accuracy-class envelope without weakening the high-order gate
GC execution schema closure and resolved cutoffs are recorded with DIAGNOSTIC policy and become hard only with REQUIRE policy
GC values are compared with Stoermer for context only because guiding-center and full-orbit trajectories are not the same physical observable
Selected GC movers are compared with one another and become a hard capability check only under REQUIRE policy

scope: required cases when diagnostics are present
description: If AMPS reports totalTasks and the all-rank task sum both must close against the independently constructed shell inventory
Elapsed runtime is recorded but is not a portable scientific pass/fail criterion
